anomalies.description: A large, rapidly expanding fireball erupts inside a wooden structure, with intense orange and yellow flames and smoke filling the interior space.

A large, rapidly expanding fireball erupts inside a wooden structure (likely a barn or hangar), with intense orange-white flames and smoke propagating from right to left across the interior; visible structural elements (beams, roof) remain intact initially.; A massive external explosion occurs at a metal lattice tower structure, producing a violent fireball with black smoke against a clear blue sky; the explosion propagates upward and outward over multiple frames.

A massive structural explosion occurs at a large metal lattice tower (e.g., radar dish or antenna array), producing a violent fireball with black smoke and debris; the tower is visibly deforming and collapsing during this interval.; A large, sustained explosion involving a metallic lattice structure (likely a tower or antenna), producing intense orange-red fireball, thick black and white smoke, and structural disintegration; debris is ejected outward and downward over multiple frames.

The aftermath of the tower explosion continues with intense, turbulent fire and smoke; fragments are seen falling through the inferno, and a helicopter appears in frame f11, indicating ongoing response or observation.

A large, sudden explosion occurs with intense orange fireball and debris ejection; the structure appears to be collapsing immediately after detonation.; Sustained structural collapse and secondary fires following the initial explosion; multiple frames show burning wreckage, falling metal trusses, and smoke—indicating ongoing explosive aftermath rather than a new discrete blast.

Sudden, intense ignition and rapid expansion of fire within the structural wreckage, visible as a bright orange flash and violent displacement of debris and smoke at f3 (21.5s), escalating through f4 (22.0s).

Second distinct explosive event: a localized but powerful burst of flame and flying embers erupts from the lower-left structure between f7 (23.5s) and f8 (24.0s), causing a sharp increase in fire intensity and debris motion.
